long first = scanner.nextLong();
long second = scanner.nextLong();
long result = 0;
if (first + second < 5) {
    System.out.println("0");
} else {
    if (first == 1 || second == 1) {
        long total = first + second - 1;
        long quotient = total / 6;
        long remainder = 0;
        if (total % 6 == 4) remainder += 2;
        if (total % 6 == 5) remainder += 4;
        result = quotient * 6 + remainder;
        System.out.println(result);
        return;

    if ((first % 4 != 0) && (second % 4 != 0) && (first + second) % 4 == 1 && (first * second) < 15)
        result -= 2;
    System.out.println(result);
}
}
}
